name: LUFFY
hints: Ate the Gomu Gomu no Mi, turning his body into rubber.
Captain of the Straw Hat Pirates aiming to become King of the Pirates.
Wears a straw hat given to him by Red-Haired Shanks.

name: ZORO
hints: Wields three swords at once, holding one in his mouth.
Has an awful sense of direction and constantly gets lost.
A green-haired swordsman aiming to surpass Dracule Mihawk.

name: NAMI
hints: Uses the Clima-Tact to control weather and summon lightning.
Loves money and tangerine trees, with a pinwheel tattoo on her shoulder.
Navigator of the Straw Hat Pirates.

name: SANJI
hints: Fights exclusively with kicks so he never damages his hands.
Trained under Red-Leg Zeff at the floating restaurant Baratie.
The chain-smoking cook of the Straw Hat Pirates.

name: SHANKS
hints: Lost his left arm saving a young Luffy from a Sea King.
Has three scars over his left eye given to him by Blackbeard.
Captain of the Red Hair Pirates and one of the Four Emperors.

name: ACE
hints: Ate the Mera Mera no Mi, giving him control over fire.
Served as commander of the Whitebeard Pirates' 2nd division.
Luffy's sworn older brother who wears an orange cowboy hat.

name: LAW
hints: Ate the Ope Ope no Mi, allowing him to create spatial 'Rooms'.
Wields the cursed nodachi Kikoku and has 'DEATH' tattooed on his fingers.
Captain of the Heart Pirates known as the Surgeon of Death.

name: CHOPPER
hints: A blue-nosed reindeer who ate the Hito Hito no Mi.
Uses Rumble Balls to access different transformation points.
Doctor of the Straw Hat Pirates who loves cotton candy.

name: EREN
hints: Inherits the Attack, Founding, and War Hammer Titans.
Grew up in Shiganshina District before Wall Maria was breached.
Swore to wipe out all Titans after watching his mother get eaten.

name: MIKASA
hints: Wears a red scarf that Eren wrapped around her as a child.
Graduated first in the 104th Training Corps.
An elite Survey Corps soldier with awakened Ackerman combat instincts.

name: ARMIN
hints: Inherited the Colossal Titan after Bertolt Hoover.
Dreamed of seeing the ocean beyond the walls using his grandfather's book.
Childhood friend of Eren and Mikasa known for his tactical brilliance.

name: LEVI
hints: Grew up in the Underground city before being recruited by Erwin Smith.
Obsessed with cleanliness and holds his teacup by the rim.
Captain of the Special Operations Squad known as humanity's strongest soldier.

name: ERWIN
hints: Lost his right arm to a Titan while rescuing Eren.
Devised the Long-Distance Enemy Scouting Formation.
The 13th Commander of the Survey Corps.

name: HANGE
hints: Captured two Titans named Sawney and Bean for experiments.
Succeeded Erwin Smith as the 14th Commander of the Survey Corps.
Wears goggles and gets overly excited studying Titans.

name: REINER
hints: Infiltrated Paradis Island as a Warrior from Marley.
Developed a split personality from the guilt of his actions.
Possesses the power of the Armored Titan.

name: SUBARU
hints: Summoned to Lugunica right after walking out of a convenience store.
Wears a black-and-orange tracksuit and uses a whip later in the series.
Possesses Return by Death, rewinding time whenever he dies.

name: REM
hints: Wields a spiked morningstar flail and manifests a single white horn.
Has short blue hair and is fiercely devoted to Subaru.
Works as a maid at Roswaal's mansion alongside her twin sister Ram.

name: RAM
hints: Uses wind magic and shares a clairvoyant link with birds.
Lost her horn as a child protecting her village from the Witch Cult.
Rem's pink-haired older twin sister who works as a maid for Roswaal.

name: EMILIA
hints: Contracted to a small grey cat-like spirit named Puck.
Has silver hair and purple eyes, causing people to fear her resemblance to Satella.
A half-elf candidate in the Royal Selection of Lugunica.

name: BEATRICE
hints: Ends her sentences with 'I suppose' and has twin drill curls.
Guarded the Forbidden Library at Roswaal's mansion for 400 years.
An artificial spirit created by Echidna who forms a contract with Subaru.

name: ROSWALL
hints: Dresses like a court jester with heavy clown makeup and heterochromatic eyes.
Extends his life by transferring his soul into his own descendants.
The margrave who sponsors Emilia in the Royal Selection.

name: REINHARD
hints: Can wish for almost any Divine Protection he needs in battle.
Serves as Felt's knight in the Royal Selection.
Red-haired Sword Saint considered the strongest fighter in Lugunica.

name: YUJI
hints: Swallowed a rotting cursed finger to save his schoolmates.
Uses Divergent Fist and lands consecutive Black Flashes.
Pink-haired vessel of Ryomen Sukuna.

name: GOJO
hints: Born with both the Six Eyes and the Limitless cursed technique.
Uses Domain Expansion: Infinite Void.
White-haired teacher at Tokyo Jujutsu High who wears a black blindfold.

name: MEGUMI
hints: Forms shadow puppets with his hands to summon shikigami like Divine Dogs.
Uses Domain Expansion: Chimera Shadow Garden.
Inherited the Zenin clan's prized Ten Shadows Technique.

name: NOBARA
hints: Channels cursed energy through a hammer, nails, and a straw doll.
Uses Straw Doll Technique: Resonance and Hairpin.
Moved from the countryside to Tokyo mainly for shopping and city life.

name: SUKUNA
hints: Uses slashing techniques called Dismantle and Cleave.
His Domain Expansion is Malevolent Shrine.
The King of Curses incarnated inside Yuji Itadori.

name: NANAMI
hints: Uses the Ratio Technique to create forced weak spots at a 7:3 ratio.
Left jujutsu society to work as a salaryman before returning.
Wears a tailored suit, yellow tie, and bladed weapon wrapped in cloth.

name: YUTA
hints: Haunted by the vengeful spirit of his childhood friend Rika Orimoto.
Can copy other sorcerers' cursed techniques.
One of the four Special Grade jujutsu sorcerers.

name: TANJIRO
hints: Possesses an extraordinarily sharp sense of smell and a hard forehead.
Uses both Water Breathing and Hinokami Kagura (Sun Breathing).
Carries his demon sister Nezuko in a wooden box on his back.

name: NEZUKO
hints: Recovers energy by sleeping instead of eating humans.
Uses Blood Demon Art: Exploding Blood to burn demons.
Wears a bamboo muzzle and can shrink to fit inside a wooden box.

name: ZENITSU
hints: Only mastered Thunder Breathing First Form: Thunderclap and Flash.
Fights at blinding speed while fast asleep.
Has bright yellow hair and constantly tries to propose to Nezuko.

name: INOSUKE
hints: Created Beast Breathing after being raised by wild boars in the mountains.
Chips his own Nichirin blades with a rock to make them serrated.
Wears a hollowed-out grey boar head over his surprisingly pretty face.

name: RENGOKU
hints: Shouts 'Umai!' loudly while eating bento boxes on the Mugen Train.
Fought Upper Rank Three Akaza to protect 200 passengers.
The Flame Hashira with red-and-yellow flame-like hair.

name: GIYU
hints: Created the Eleventh Form of Water Breathing: Dead Calm.
Wears a half-and-half haori split between solid red and a geometric pattern.
The stoic Water Hashira who spared Nezuko when he first met Tanjiro.

name: SHINOBU
hints: Uses a modified stinger-like Nichirin blade coated in wisteria poison.
Wears a butterfly hairpin and a wing-patterned haori.
The Insect Hashira who runs the Butterfly Mansion.

name: NARUTO
hints: Has the Nine-Tailed Fox Kurama sealed inside his stomach.
Signatures include Shadow Clone Jutsu and the Rasengan.
Loves Ichiraku Ramen and dreams of becoming Hokage.

name: SASUKE
hints: Awakened the Sharingan and later the Rinnegan in his left eye.
Left Konoha to seek power from Orochimaru to kill his brother.
Last survivor of the Uchiha clan in the Hidden Leaf Village.

name: SAKURA
hints: Trained under Tsunade to master medical ninjutsu and monstrous strength.
Awakened the Strength of a Hundred Seal on her forehead.
Pink-haired kunoichi of Team 7.

name: KAKASHI
hints: Created the Lightning Blade (Chidori) as a young jonin.
Always shows up late and reads 'Make-Out Paradise' in public.
Leader of Team 7 known across nations as the Copy Ninja.

name: ITACHI
hints: Uses Tsukuyomi, Amaterasu, and Susanoo with his Mangekyo Sharingan.
Joined the Akatsuki as a double agent after wiping out his clan.
Sasuke's older brother who pokes his forehead before parting.

name: GAARA
hints: Carries a giant gourd on his back filled with chakra-infused sand.
Had the One-Tail Shukaku sealed inside him before birth.
Has the kanji for 'love' tattooed on his forehead and becomes Fifth Kazekage.

name: JIRAIYA
hints: One of the Legendary Sannin who summons giant toads from Mount Myoboku.
Author of the 'Make-Out Paradise' novel series.
Taught the Rasengan to both Minato and Naruto.

name: GON
hints: Grew up on Whale Island and uses a fishing rod early in the series.
Created the Enhancer technique Jajanken based on rock-paper-scissors.
Took the Hunter Exam to find his father Ging.

name: KILLUA
hints: Transmutes his aura into electricity for techniques like Godspeed.
Ran away from his family's estate on Kukuroo Mountain.
White-haired best friend of Gon from a famous family of assassins.

name: KURAPIKA
hints: Conjures five chains on his right hand, including Chain Jail for the Spiders.
His eyes turn scarlet whenever he experiences intense emotion.
The sole survivor of the Kurta clan seeking revenge on the Phantom Troupe.

name: HISOKA
hints: His Nen ability Bungee Gum has the properties of both rubber and gum.
Uses playing cards as deadly weapons and paints a star and teardrop on his face.
A thrill-seeking magician obsessed with fighting strong opponents.

name: MERUEM
hints: Grows stronger by consuming the aura of other Nen users.
Spent his final days playing Gungi against a blind girl named Komugi.
The King of the Chimera Ants.

name: CHROLLO
hints: Uses Skill Hunter to steal other people's Nen abilities into a conjured book.
Wears an inverted cross tattoo on his forehead and a fur-collared coat.
Founder and leader of the Phantom Troupe.

name: DENJI
hints: Fused with his pet devil Pochita, who replaced his heart.
Pulls a starter cord on his chest to sprout chainsaws from his head and arms.
Joined Public Safety mainly for toast with jam and a normal life.

name: POWER
hints: Manipulates her own blood to form hammers and spears.
Refuses to flush the toilet or eat vegetables and loves her cat Meowy.
The Blood Fiend partnered with Denji in Division 4.

name: AKI
hints: Contracted with the Fox Devil, Curse Devil, and Future Devil.
Wears his hair in a topknot and shares an apartment with Denji and Power.
A Public Safety Devil Hunter seeking revenge on the Gun Devil.

name: MAKIMA
hints: Has golden ringed eyes and wears her red hair in a long braid.
Can control anyone she believes is inferior to herself.
The Control Devil posing as a high-ranking Public Safety leader.

name: DEKU
hints: Born quirkless before inheriting One For All from All Might.
Keeps detailed notebooks analyzing heroes' quirks and fighting styles.
Green-haired U.A. student whose hero name comes from a childhood insult.

name: BAKUGO
hints: Secretes nitroglycerin-like sweat from his palms to create explosions.
Chose the hero name Great Explosion Murder God Dynamight.
Deku's explosive childhood rival with spiky ash-blond hair.

name: SHOTO
hints: Uses Half-Cold Half-Hot, generating ice from his right side and fire from his left.
Has white-and-red split hair and a burn scar over his left eye.
Youngest son of the Flame Hero Endeavor.

name: ALLMIGHT
hints: Can only maintain his muscular hero form for a limited time after a severe injury.
Names his signature punches after American states like Detroit and United States of Smash.
The eighth holder of One For All and former Symbol of Peace.

name: GOKU
hints: Born on Planet Vegeta as Kakarot and sent to Earth as an infant.
Signature moves include the Kamehameha, Spirit Bomb, and Instant Transmission.
A Saiyan martial artist who constantly trains to fight stronger foes.

name: VEGETA
hints: Uses signature energy attacks like Galick Gun and Final Flash.
Married Bulma and fathered Trunks and Bulla.
The proud Prince of all Saiyans and Goku's lifelong rival.

name: GOHAN
hints: Trained by Piccolo as a child and later fought crime as the Great Saiyaman.
First Saiyan to achieve Super Saiyan 2 during the Cell Games.
Goku and Chi-Chi's eldest son who becomes a scholar.

name: PICCOLO
hints: Uses the Special Beam Cannon and can stretch his arms or regenerate limbs.
Fused with Nail and Kami to dramatically increase his power.
A green Namekian warrior who became Gohan's mentor.

name: FRIEZA
hints: Destroyed Planet Vegeta out of fear of the Super Saiyan legend.
Unlocked a Golden form after training for the first time in his life.
Tyrant of the universe who fought Goku on Planet Namek.

name: ICHIGO
hints: Gained Soul Reaper powers after Rukia Kuchiki transferred hers to him.
Wields Zangetsu and fires crescent-shaped Getsuga Tensho blasts.
Orange-haired Substitute Soul Reaper who also possesses Hollow and Quincy powers.

name: AIZEN
hints: His Zanpakuto Kyoka Suigetsu induces complete hypnosis upon viewing its release.
Faked his own death before defecting to Hueco Mundo to lead the Arrancar.
Former captain of the 5th Division who slicked back his hair after betraying Soul Society.

name: RUKIA
hints: Wields Sode no Shirayuki, an ice-type Zanpakuto.
Loves drawing terrible bunny sketches to explain Soul Reaper concepts.
The Soul Reaper who gave Ichigo his powers in Karakura Town.

name: KENPACHI
hints: Wears an eyepatch that constantly absorbs his spiritual pressure to make fights last longer.
Wears bells in his spiky hair so enemies can hear him coming.
Captain of the 11th Division who lives solely for battle.

name: EDWARD
hints: Can perform alchemy simply by clapping his hands together without a circle.
Goes into a rage whenever anyone comments on his short height.
The Fullmetal Alchemist with a mechanical automail right arm and left leg.

name: ALPHONSE
hints: Has a blood seal painted inside the back of his neck.
Loves stray cats and often hides them inside his chest plate.
Edward's younger brother whose soul is bound to a giant suit of steel armor.

name: ROY
hints: Wears white gloves made of ignition cloth to create sparks with a snap.
Becomes completely useless in combat whenever it rains.
The Flame Alchemist aiming to become Fuhrer of Amestris.

name: LOID
hints: Works undercover as a psychiatrist at Berlint General Hospital.
Master of disguise who created a fake family for Operation Strix.
Westalis's top spy codenamed Twilight.

name: YOR
hints: Works at Berlint City Hall by day and takes contracts from Garden by night.
Can barely cook anything edible other than her mother's stew.
A superhumanly strong assassin codenamed Thorn Princess.

name: ANYA
hints: Loves peanuts, Bond the dog, and the cartoon 'Spy Wars'.
Attends Eden Academy and tries to earn Stella Stars to help her dad's mission.
A pink-haired telepath who can read everyone's minds.

name: FRIEREN
hints: Constantly falls for obvious mimic chest traps because there is a 1% chance of a grimoire.
Suppresses her mana so demons underestimate her, earning the title Frieren the Slayer.
An elf mage over a thousand years old who outlived her adventuring party.

name: FERN
hints: War orphan raised by Heiter before becoming Frieren's apprentice.
Fires rapid-fire Zoltraak blasts and acts like a strict mother toward Frieren.
A young purple-haired mage who becomes a First-Class Mage.

name: HIMMEL
hints: Left statues of himself in towns across the continent so Frieren wouldn't feel alone.
Wielded a replica Hero's Sword after failing to pull the real one from the stone.
The narcissistic yet deeply kind hero who led the party that defeated the Demon King.

name: LIGHT
hints: Picked up a supernatural notebook dropped by the Shinigami Ryuk.
Uses a miniature LCD TV hidden inside a bag of potato chips to write names.
A top student who becomes the vigilante killer known as Kira.

name: L
hints: Sits crouched in chairs and constantly eats sweets and cake.
Operates from Wammy's House and only shows a gothic letter on screens.
The world's greatest detective trying to prove Light Yagami is Kira.

name: RYUK
hints: Suffers withdrawal symptoms if he goes too long without eating apples.
Dropped his notebook into the human world purely out of boredom.
The Shinigami who follows Light Yagami around.

name: SPIKE
hints: Has a cybernetic right eye that sees the past while his left sees the present.
Practices Jeet Kune Do and pilots the red Swordfish II.
A former Red Dragon Syndicate hitman turned space bounty hunter.

name: FAYE
hints: Woke up from cryogenic sleep 54 years after a space shuttle accident with massive debt.
Pilots the Red Tail and wears a yellow outfit with a red jacket.
A gambling con artist who joins the crew of the Bebop.

name: LELOUCH
hints: Received the Power of Absolute Obedience from C.C. in his left eye.
Attends Ashford Academy while secretly leading the Black Knights.
An exiled Britannian prince who wears a mask under the alias Zero.

name: CC
hints: Obsessed with Pizza Hut pizza and Cheese-kun plushies.
Immortal witch who granted Lelouch his Geass power.
A green-haired girl who acts as Lelouch's accomplice.

name: THORFINN
hints: Followed Askeladd's mercenary band for years seeking a duel to avenge his father Thors.
Later enslaved on Ketil's farm where he vowed to become a true warrior without violence.
Icelandic protagonist seeking a peaceful land across the sea.

name: ASKELADD
hints: Half-Welsh, half-Danish mercenary leader who secretly despised Vikings.
Killed King Sweyn in front of the royal court to protect Wales and crown Canute.
The cunning mercenary captain who killed Thors and mentored Thorfinn.

name: SAITAMA
hints: Did 100 push-ups, 100 sit-ups, 100 squats, and a 10km run daily until his hair fell out.
Registered as Caped Baldy and cares more about supermarket sales than fame.
A hero for fun who defeats every enemy with a single punch.

name: GENOS
hints: Became a cyborg after a rampaging cyborg destroyed his hometown.
Takes notes on everything Saitama says, convinced it is deep training wisdom.
S-Class Rank 14 hero known as the Demon Cyborg.

name: OKABE
hints: Calls himself the mad scientist Hououin Kyouma and talks into a turned-off phone.
Retains memories across shifting world lines via Reading Steiner.
Founder of the Future Gadget Laboratory in Akihabara.

name: KURISU
hints: Published a neuroscience paper in Science at age 17.
Often called 'Christina' or 'Assistant' by Okabe, which she denies.
Helped turn the Phone Microwave into a functioning time machine.

name: KIRITO
hints: Unlocked the Dual Blades skill and wields Elucidator and Dark Repulser.
A beta tester labeled a 'Beater' during the early floors of Aincrad.
The Black Swordsman who cleared Sword Art Online.

name: ASUNA
hints: Earned the nickname 'The Flash' for her blinding rapier speed.
Served as vice-commander of the Knights of the Blood Oath.
Fell in love with Kirito while trapped inside Aincrad.

name: RUDEUS
hints: Earned the nickname 'Quagmire' as an adventurer in the northern territories.
Learned voiceless incantation magic after being reincarnated with past-life memories.
Trained in water magic by Roxy Migurdia as a child.

name: ROXY
hints: A Migurd demon who looks like a young girl despite being decades old.
Cannot use her tribe's telepathy, which led her to leave her village.
Blue-haired water mage who served as Rudeus's childhood tutor.
